question.text: Magadha Growth Fund's unlisted investee has PAT of INR 40 crore and 4 crore shares outstanding. Listed peers trade at P/E of 30x. Applying a 30% DLOM, what is the estimated market price per share?

explanation.text: The Logic: EPS = 40 / 4 = INR 10. Applying the 30% DLOM stated in the stem, the unlisted P/E = 30 x (1 - 0.30) = 21x. Price per share = 21 x 10 = INR 210. The Trap: INR 300 ignores the DLOM. INR 240 implies a 20% DLOM. INR 270 implies a 10% DLOM. None match the 30% DLOM specified in the stem. Note: The workbook supports P/E as a market multiple that can be used to compare unlisted alternative-space companies with listed peers, with an illiquidity discount normally applied to the quoted-market ratio for unlisted stock.
